title: Knight Facing Dragon
description: A knight in full armor with a red cape stands on rocky ground holding a sword pointed forward. In the sky above looms a large brown dragon looking down at the knight.
prompt: A knight in silver armor and flowing red cape stands on broken rocky ground holding a long sword pointed up at a giant brown dragon hovering in the air above him. The dragon has spikes and sharp teeth and looks down at the knight. The background is a hazy sky with yellow paint marks and brush strokes. The ground has orange patches and the knight's cape blows in the wind.
